name: LoggingApp Demo
description: A Logging app that demonstrates logging with mw::log with kConsole|kRemote|kFile config.

args: (cd /usr/bin/datarouter && exec ./datarouter --no_adaptive_runtime) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & dr=$!; (cd /showcases/data/logging/logging_app/etc && exec /showcases/bin/logging_app) & app=$!; (cd /showcases/data/logging/dlt_generator/etc && exec /showcases/bin/dlt_generator) & gen=$!; wait $app; rc=$?; wait $gen || rc=$?; kill $dr; wait $dr; exit $rc
